overrides_applied.reason: CardPipeline cap_rules is empty. Issuer T&C: Rs 4,000 cashback per statement quarter, separately for Flipkart, Myntra and Cleartrip. Loader period mapping for a statement-cycle quarter is to be confirmed by WP2 (closest: quarter).
Cashback is rounded down per transaction (11.80 -> 11).
WP7: The free-text sub-category made the 5% Flipkart rule info; Flipkart Health is restated as an except list below.

WP7: Flipkart Axis cashback T&C: 5% "Valid on the website as well as mobile application of Flipkart excluding Flipkart Health". except_merchant_slugs [flipkart_health] (D16a) makes the rule v2-only (D16c), so the v1 substring "flipkart" no longer pays 5% at Flipkart Health.

WP7: D25d: cashback T&C exclude "purchase of gold (in any form - gold bar, gold coin, jewelry, artifact etc.)" and the MCC category "Clock, Jewelry, Watch and Silverware Stores"; the extra free-text key made it info.
WP7: MCC-scoped jewellery exclusion in any category.
WP7: D25d: cashback T&C exclude the MCC category "Educational Services"; the third-party-app wording made it info. Category plus education MCC rows (D20a).
WP7: D24e/D25d: cashback T&C exclude "EMI transactions, purchases converted to EMI post-facto"; the record's row is category emi AND rail emi.
